Event: Varworth summit.
Budget: 41,000.
Staffing: Una is out; Pia is covering. Greta is out; Opal is covering. Bram is out for the rest of the week; Greta is covering. Ada and Finn are swapping desks. Cora and Nils are swapping desks.
Logistics: Print room is being repainted, causing morning noise. Loading bay is being repainted, causing evening noise. Coffee machine in the east wing is operational. Pia requests the harbour room be kept clear for visitors. Lift near the north office is slow. Afternoon stand-up moved to the east wing. North office is free in the morning. An umbrella was left in the north office. Another umbrella was left in the loading bay.
Status: Print room noise noted for morning; loading bay noise for evening. East wing coffee machine confirmed working. Harbour room reserved for visitors. Kira also requests the print room be kept clear for visitors. Notes from morning meeting need to be sent to Una. Notes from afternoon meeting need to be sent to Opal.
